title: Release publishing jobs restore no Actions cache that a less-trusted workflow run could have written, and docker.yml's PR-dispatch path neither restores nor saves a cache in the default-branch scope

criteria.then: it restores no Actions cache: no setup-java/setup-node `cache:` input, no `cache-from` input and no actions/cache restore step (releases are rare; a cold build is the accepted trade)

its setup-java `cache:` input is not a plain literal but an expression gated on needs.target.outputs.pr, so a run dispatched with `pr` (PR content executed on the default-branch ref) gets no Maven cache restore or save
its BuildKit `cache-from` and `cache-to` inputs are expression-gated on needs.target.outputs.pr, so a PR dispatch neither restores nor saves a type=gha cache in the default-branch scope
a test file pins both rules: release.yml restores no cache, and docker.yml's PR-dispatch path is cache-gated
